token = resp['access_token']

def fetch_playlists(is_public):
    all_pl=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token,is_public=is_public,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
        print('is_public',is_public,'page',page_index,'returned',len(page) if page else None)
        if not page:
            break
        all_pl.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return all_pl

pl_private = fetch_playlists(False)
pl_public = fetch_playlists(True)
all_pl = {pl['playlist_id']:pl for pl in (pl_private+pl_public)}
print('private_count',len(pl_private),'public_count',len(pl_public),'unique_total',len(all_pl))
print('unique_ids_sample',list(all_pl.keys())[:10])
# gather song_ids
song_ids=set()
for pl in all_pl.values():
    for sid in pl.get('song_ids',[]):
        song_ids.add(sid)
print('unique_song_ids',len(song_ids))
print('song_ids_sample',sorted(song_ids)[:20])
# show playlist title counts
print('playlist_titles',[ (pl['playlist_id'],pl['title'],len(pl.get('song_ids',[]))) for pl in list(all_pl.values())[:5] ])

token = resp['access_token']
all_song_ids = sorted(list(song_id_set))
classical_song_ids=[]
classical_artist_ids=set()
classical_artists=[]
# fetch songs and identify classical
for idx,sid in enumerate(all_song_ids):
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    if s.get('genre')=='classical':
        classical_song_ids.append(sid)
        for a in s.get('artists',[]):
            classical_artist_ids.add(a['id'])
        # store a quick snapshot for first few
        if len(classical_song_ids)<=5:
            classical_artists.append((sid,s['title'],[a['id'] for a in s.get('artists',[])]))
print('total_songs_considered',len(all_song_ids))
print('classical_song_count',len(classical_song_ids))
print('classical_song_sample',classical_artists)
print('unique_classical_artist_count',len(classical_artist_ids))
print('classical_artist_ids_sample',sorted(classical_artist_ids)[:30])
